title: Owner: watch Misato and a consultant think on the dashboard
goal: The owner sees a named, timed thinking state appear and disappear on the dashboard
acceptance: After the update reaches NERV-01 (`nerv update` or the dashboard's update button), open the dashboard with `nerv open` and keep the Marduk Institute · Pilots panel and the Sorties list in view. In the chat box paste: `pianifica una cena per sabato con tre ospiti`. Expected while NERV works: at the top of the Pilots panel a line such as `● Generic pilot · Consultant (gemma4:26b) · S-1A2B · thinking 3 s` whose seconds count up by themselves (a specialist shows its own name, e.g. `Pilot Ada`), a THINKING badge on that pilot's card (the Generic pilot card when no specialist matched), then `● Misato · Planner (<model>) · S-1A2B · thinking N s` while Misato plans; the sortie card shows the same line under its title. (No consultant line appears if no consultant is configured: `nerv models` shows roles.consultant.) Expected after the answer: the lines and the badge are gone, and the EVA cages header still says how many EVA jobs are active (`0 active` if none ran), never counting the thinking

Second check: paste the same chat request again and, while a thinking line is counting, run in a terminal: `nerv service stop && nerv service start` (there is no `nerv service restart`; these two are the restart). Expected: once the dashboard reconnects (a few seconds after the start), no thinking line or THINKING badge is left; nothing stays counting
Report what you see (or a screenshot) in chat; the agent records the result in F-148's Verification
privacy: Neutral invented pilots, sorties and models only; no owner data or tokens in Git, tests or logs.
validation: Owner check, recorded in F-148 Verification
escalation: The owner decides whether the display is enough; the agent records the result

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: two short checks on the Mac. Not a measurement.
